desktop.methods: Readiness and validation Processing checks passed. LeafView uses the supplied model and reference files.Reproduction of the original training-period results remains unverified because historical feature rows are unavailable.Rolling-window construction and numerical consistency are checked, but rolling-window prediction accuracy has not been evaluated. These checks establish preprocessing compatibility, not prediction accuracy. LeafView applies Yixuan Li's selected 600-tree XGBoost model to GOES-19 red, near-infrared, and shortwave-infrared reflectance statistics, viewing and illumination geometry, seasonality, and IGBP land cover. The model preserves separate 15, 18, and 21 UTC composites. Each window contains eight UTC calendar dates. Seasonality is calculated from the window's start date with the notebook's formula. LeafView only uses windows whose observations are all after the model's April 6, 2026 training cutoff. Results after that cutoff test how the trained model transfers to later observations; they are not forecasts. Rolling-window construction and numerical consistency are checked separately. Prediction accuracy for daily rolling windows has not been evaluated. The training reference is a quality-screened MODIS/VIIRS satellite consensus, not direct field ground truth. LAI is leaf area per ground area; it is not a direct plant-health score, drought diagnosis, or irrigation recommendation. No differences from the supplied preprocessing were identified for this query. The known solar-angle issue below remains. Model-compatibility concern The original helper calculates solar direction differently from its stated convention. LeafView preserves that calculation to match the model's training inputs. Correcting it would require separate evaluation and potentially retraining.
